title: A Nabatara Àjà n'Ebere
intro: Mechie anya gị ma lee anya n'ugwu dị ukwuu, nke na-adịghị ekwu okwu ebe a na-anwale okwukwe ruo n'ókè ya. Ị na-achọ izute onye nrubeisi ya dị jụụ n'ihu iwu a na-apụghị ichetụ n'echiche gbanwere oge ọnwụnwa ka ọ bụrụ ihe nnọchianya ebighị ebi nke nrubeisi na ebere Chineke.
clues: A na-echeta m n'ime Quran n'ime ndị tachiri obi na ndidi siri ike.
Anọ m n'etiti ọhụụ nke nwalere nrubeisi nye iwu Allah.
Mgbe a gwara m ọhụụ ahụ, m kwuru ka m mee ihe e nyere m n'iwu, ị ga-ahụkwa m n'etiti onye ọrịa ahụ.
E dinaara m ala maka àjà ahụ, mana Allah kpọrọ oku ka ọhụụ ahụ mezuo.
Allah ji nnukwu àjà gbapụta m, wee hapụ nsọpụrụ nye m n'etiti ọgbọ ndị ga-abịa.
Abụ m Ismail, onye ya na Ibrahim weliri ntọala nke Ụlọ Nsọ ahụ, nke a kpọtụrụ aha ya na Idris na Dhul-Kifl n'etiti ndị ezi omume.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịkpọ ndị nwụrụ anwụ ka ha dị ndụ site n'ikike Allah
Àjà e nyere n'iwu na nrubeisi n'obi
Ịbụ onye azụ̀ dị egwu loro
trial.answer: Àjà e nyere n'iwu na nrubeisi n'obi

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Ehi ọlaedo a na-efe mgbe ọ nọghị ya
Ebule ukwu e zigara dị ka ihe mgbapụta
location.answer: Ebule ukwu e zigara dị ka ihe mgbapụta

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Mgbọ dị egwu tụrụ m n'anya maka ịjụ nne kamel ahụ
A na-eto ya n'etiti ndị amụma nwere ndidi na ezi omume
Mmiri mikpuru m n'oké osimiri ka m na-achụ ndị kwere ekwe
outcome.answer: A na-eto ya n'etiti ndị amụma nwere ndidi na ezi omume

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
